candidates.author: Flickr 13910409@N05 (Madang Resort Hotel, near the market)
candidates.reason: Covered market hall with stalls of fruit and veg and shoppers; Flickr title Madang Resort Hotel, Madang, PNG, 'market near Madang Resort Hotel'. Largest size 1800x1200 (>=1280): https://live.staticflickr.com/7297/12767633773_0897840bf5_o.jpg. Dated snapshot (Flickr date ~2000, not before 2000), people prominent but it is the market; acceptable for lack of better. Page names a market near the hotel, so identity as Madang Central Market is not fully proven.
